mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ntf_delivery (delivery_id, dedup_key, channel, recipient, notice_json, status, attempts) VALUES (#{deliveryId}, #{dedupKey}, #{channel}, #{recipient}, CAST(#{noticeJson} AS jsonb), #{status}, #{attempts}) ON CONFLICT (dedup_key) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT delivery_id AS deliveryId, dedup_key AS dedupKey, channel, recipient, notice_json AS noticeJson, status, external_ref AS externalRef, attempts, last_error AS lastError, created_at AS createdAt, sent_at AS sentAt FROM ntf_delivery WHERE delivery_id = #{deliveryId}
